## 1. Summary

实施本轮完整Spec及三个规范附录（当前Draft待DEC-007批准），共19个逻辑Step。先共同观测/proof与scope/RPC、平台/Edge，随后Outbox/JPA兼容、显式目录/字段owner、四native、五前端、生成与运行harness，最后真实隔离联调与最终Spec审计。每Step编译成立、行为RED/GREEN及Manual Checks完成后一次focused commit，记录新HEAD与精确paths后再下一Step。

0.2.5已完成发布及两自身前端使用，本Plan不重新发布；只安装至余下三个真实消费方。源码/受控/生成/本机真实证据分开；19Steps全部完成并通过所列requiredlivecases才可判完整接入，不将Spec validator或fixtureE2E当运行结果。

本Plan完整Draft待DEC-007/008及整文批准；未来命令不表示执行通过。Spec/Plan精确修订执行批准前，不修改源码、写数据库或启动进程作为文档副作用。此前六项决策与运行范围授权保持，不重复索要它们。

### 2.3 Superseded or excluded content

旧自身Spec §3.2其他平台/模板排除只在本轮解除；旧第一方可有限多aud方案在本轮改为独立resource client/token；Agent旧API-key身份与禁必要Tianshu/RPC边界由DEC001替换，研究/知识业务与六层不改。已完成旧Plan不在新Steps重新计数。未定义native query字段READ/mask差异保持原safeprojection/SDL，新增声明需后续业务合同，不能声称本轮自动Jackson保护GraphQL/PB。

Requirement ID必须连同来源文档理解，不能把几个Spec同名REQ当作同义。本轮主Spec只有REQ-001–013。历史依赖的REQ-014–048在Step18按来源核对保持/替代结果：自身Spec的规范、配置、TLS、0.2.5制品、关系模型/历史DDL及诚实验收保持；OAuth基线的审计、指标、PLATFORM隔离、旧数据保护、Java规范保持。OAuth基线REQ-019“仅Spec/禁generator”与自身REQ-018原阶段的generator排除是历史阶段过程约束，本轮用户明确要求完整接入及对应生成验证后不再限制当前执行；不是修改它们的Accepted原文或重新实现历史Steps。§10按来源列出，不将这些过程约束误报成新的业务需求。当前代码修订REQ-020–048的已执行认证存储、密码/密钥/加密、目录、client/grant版本、真实SAS、BFF和前端事实只作为本轮消费方的兼容基线；Agent原研究/知识库业务合同按Context-only冻结保留。历史生产迁移、多实例传播等未运行项目不在本轮虚报通过，也不因加入dependency就自动变成本次生产迁移任务。

## 4. Implementation Strategy and Dependency Order

### 4.1 Ordered strategy

Steps1–7建立SDK/平台/Edge；8先补必要Outbox同DS JPA兼容，9–10完成显式目录与规则owner；11–14接入四native，15五Web与制品，16边界及全7生成，17隔离harness，18真实两phase与全部livecases，19最终审计。未做数据库schema变更；已有SQL/history全Keep，testnewDB只运行既有权威schema。

### 4.2 Test-first strategy

所有行为Step从当前已有JUnit/MockMvc/GraphQlTester/Vertx Reactor/RPC/Vitest/脚本contract的一份可编译失败测试开始；合约type若必须先定义，只是compile前置不冒充RED。失败必须为旧行为（proof丢失、scope绕过、header信任、旧BFF复活、缺writer、缺actor、旧包接口等），而非404制品/语法/环境故障。每Step具体RED/GREEN命令在§7；默认测试不启动PG/Redis/Docker。真实18不是unitRED，使用已完成17的harness与用户已授权runtime。

### 4.3 Sequential and parallel boundaries

DEC-007新增Step8的9路径已在主Spec§7.0.1完整列明；拒绝双TM/producer REQUIRES_NEW，真实JPA join需受控装配和live回滚双门禁。源码Step严格顺序，N committed前不得改N+1。并行仅是只读分析、独立Plan片段审查或当前同一Step内部不重叠files的worker；所有source commit/main验证由主代理负责。共享文件的各Step按exactsymbol列出，不能一次改完后拆commit。

### 4.4 Commit boundaries

19个独立逻辑Step各最多一个focusedcommit；任何laterdefect只按原Step最小correctivecommit记录，不自动amend/squash。原Spec/Plan设计文档为一项逻辑任务，完成review后可一个focuseddocscommit。Step18运行结果只有sanitizedtest-evidence文档为commit；Step19最终审计更新Plan/Spec/runbooks，不能空commit或提交keys/PIDs/tarballs/buildoutputs。新HEAD及paths写入工作证据并在最终Plan审计归档，selfreferentialcommitHash不写入该commit本身。

### 4.8 User-mandated Java Rule Implementation Matrix

```text
1 类名规范，必须以 java的pojo规范命名。以dao po bo vo dto query command event等结尾
2 每层之间必须被 springboot-validation 校验，复用对象使用分组校验；基于原生和自定义约束注解、@Valid、@Validated 及 ConstraintValidator 扩展实现。ValidationUtils 只承担通用手工校验，不承载全部业务校验；电话号码复用 libphonenumber。
3 Java POJO 默认使用 class，注解为 @Data @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Accessors(chain = true)，按构造目标选择 @Builder 或 @SuperBuilder；父类状态参与相等性时使用 @EqualsAndHashCode(callSuper = true)。只有不可变 value object 可以使用 record，并豁免 class 的 Lombok 规范；普通实体不能因简单而使用 record。使用 MapStruct、MapStructPlus 和 egon-cola-component-common-core 的 BaseConverter（双向）或 BaseForwardConverter（不可逆投影）进行转换。
4业务类必须使用@Slf4j注解注入log对象。如果业务类被spring管理，必须指定名称，如果是单例的情况下，参考@Service("userService")。如果需要依赖注入，必须@RequiredArgsConstructor进行修饰，不要代码中写。且属性必须被@qualify修饰。
5 工具类只允许使用jdk原生、Apache Commons(commons-lang3、commons-collections4、commons-io、commons-text、commons-codec、commons-beanutils)、Guava。针对Tika按需引入。
6 JSON 使用 Spring Boot Jackson；持久化枚举值使用 @EnumValue，向前端输出的枚举值使用 @JsonValue，禁止 ordinal 作为业务编码。
7 springboot 多环境配置文件，必须保持配置一致，但值不一定一致。
9 复杂业务必须引入设计模式，不允许硬编码
10 日期相关的必须使用java.time下的实体类，不允许使用java.util下的
11 只允许现有三层结构或当前 egon-cola-archetypes 的 DDD 结构，三层结构保持现状。必须尽量复用 egon-cola-components；持久化模块必须使用 Egon COLA MP Starter，DDL 统一由 egon-mp-sdj-ext-starter 分布式管理。业务唯一键必须组合业务列与 deletedAt（数据库 deleted_at），并验证 NULL、租户及重复软删除语义。采用 CQE（Command Query Event）；Event 必须经 egon-cola-component-transactional-outbox-starter 或 MQ 中间件投递。
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
RpcConsumerBindingProperties binding = matchExactLocalBinding(inv.serviceName(),inv.group(),inv.version(),inv.fullMethodName(),inv.processIdentity().applicationName(),inv.processIdentity().env());
// USER_RELAY preserves the current verified USER capture and original forwarding interceptor.
// SERVICE only: capture verifiedTenant once here, then build the fixed validated local request.
final Context callerContext = Context.current();
final IdpServiceTokenRequest request = toFixedRequest(binding, verifiedTenant);
// In the existing ClientInterceptor.interceptCall(method, callOptions, next):
if (callOptions.getCredentials() != null) {
    throw new IllegalStateException("RPC call credentials already exist");
}
final Context.CancellableContext credentialContext = callerContext.withCancellation();
CallCredentials credentials = new CallCredentials() {
    @Override
    public void applyRequestMetadata(RequestInfo info, Executor appExecutor, MetadataApplier applier) {
        final AtomicBoolean completed = new AtomicBoolean(); // local to this applier, never shared cache state
        final Context.CancellationListener cancellation = new Context.CancellationListener() {
            @Override
            public void cancelled(Context ignored) {
                try {
                    if (completed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                        applier.fail(Status.CANCELLED.withDescription("RPC credential acquisition cancelled"));
                    }
                } finally {
                    credentialContext.removeListener(this);
                }
            }
        };
        credentialContext.addListener(cancellation, Runnable::run);
        if (completed.get()) { // addListener immediately delivers an already cancelled context
            credentialContext.removeListener(cancellation);
            return;
        }
        try {
            appExecutor.execute(credentialContext.wrap(() -> {
                try {
                    if (credentialContext.isCancelled()) {
                        cancellation.cancelled(credentialContext);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (completed.get()) return;
                    OAuth2AccessToken token = serviceClient.authorize(request);
                    Metadata metadata = new Metadata();
                    metadata.put(RpcMetadataKeys.AUTHORIZATION, bearer(token.getTokenValue()));
                    if (credentialContext.isCancelled()) {
                        cancellation.cancelled(credentialContext);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (completed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                        applier.apply(metadata);
                    }
                } catch (RuntimeException acquisitionFailure) {
                    // Boundary completion only: never expose token endpoint/cause/message to the peer.
                    if (completed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                        applier.fail(Status.UNAVAILABLE.withDescription("RPC credential acquisition unavailable"));
                    }
                } finally {
                    credentialContext.removeListener(cancellation);
                }
            }));
        } catch (RuntimeException schedulingFailure) { // includes RejectedExecutionException
            try {
                if (completed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                    applier.fail(Status.UNAVAILABLE.withDescription("RPC credential acquisition unavailable"));
                }
            } finally {
                credentialContext.removeListener(cancellation);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override public void thisUsesUnstableApi() { }
};
ClientCall<RequestT, ResponseT> delegate;
try {
    delegate = next.newCall(method, callOptions.withCallCredentials(credentials));
} catch (RuntimeException createFailure) {
    credentialContext.cancel(createFailure);
    throw createFailure;
}
return new ForwardingClientCall.SimpleForwardingClientCall<>(delegate) {
    @Override public void start(Listener<ResponseT> listener, Metadata headers) {
        try {
            // Preserve the existing headers.getAll(AUTHORIZATION) rejection before delegation.
            super.start(new ForwardingClientCallListener.SimpleForwardingClientCallListener<>(listener) {
                @Override public void onClose(Status status, Metadata trailers) {
                    try { super.onClose(status, trailers); }
                    finally { credentialContext.cancel(null); }
                }
            }, headers);
        } catch (RuntimeException startFailure) {
            credentialContext.cancel(startFailure);
            throw startFailure;
        }
    }
    @Override public void cancel(String message, Throwable cause) {
        credentialContext.cancel(cause); // immediate listener completion even while authorize is blocked
        super.cancel(message, cause);
    }
};
// Existing cache/renew-skew/single-flight stays in IdpServiceOAuth2Client, not this per-call state.
```

- Error and edge behavior: HTTP取实际request marker；非Servlet只在本Step新增的真实gRPC Context取marker。缺marker、denyOnce=false且未CONFIRMED、FAILED或closed NEW都RuntimeUnavailable，不能unaudited403；CONFIRMED只复用已确认结果。无gRPC marker的既有直接调用保留Step1 proof直交付兼容，不把Reactor请求借进无关RPC Context。
- Standards impact: MC-ARCH-001/MC-REUSE-001/MC-NAME-001/MC-VALID-001/MC-MODEL-001/MC-CONVERT-001/MC-LOG-001/MC-BEAN-001/MC-JSON-001/MC-TIME-001/MC-PATTERN-001/MC-SCOPE-001：仅现owner；标准注解/qualifiedfinal与当前converter；fixedlogs/no sensitivecopy；失败分支与Clock明确。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 1/Rule 2/Rule 3/Rule 4/Rule 5/Rule 6/Rule 9/Rule 10/Rule 11：semantic类型，Valid/commonvalidation在此handoff，普通BO完整Lombok/immutablecopy，Slf4j+namedBean+Qualifier，JDK/Jackson/java.time及已批准模式；没有DTO/PO手工拷贝/新层。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
var attrs = RequestContextHolder.getRequestAttributes();
if (!(attrs instanceof ServletRequestAttributes)
        && IdpRpcSecurityContext.currentProofOrNull() == null) {
    // No current verified RPC scope: preserve Step1's proof-aware direct caller compatibility.
    if (!observations.authorizationDenied(proof)) {
        throw new RuntimeUnavailableException("OAUTH_AUDIT_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE", identity);
    }
    return;
}
IdpAuthorizationObservationContextBO marker = attrs instanceof ServletRequestAttributes servlet
        ? IdpSecurityObservationFilter.authorizationObservationContext(servlet.getRequest())
        : IdpRpcSecurityContext.currentAuthorizationObservationContext();
// An authenticated RPC listener installed by this Step must have its request marker.
// A genuinely non-Servlet/non-RPC direct caller retains Step1's strict proof path.
if (marker == null) {
    throw new RuntimeUnavailableException("OAUTH_AUDIT_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE", identity);
}
boolean delivered = marker.denyOnce(() -> observations.authorizationDenied(proof));
if ((!delivered && !marker.isConfirmed()) || marker.isFailed()) {
    throw new RuntimeUnavailableException("OAUTH_AUDIT_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE", identity);
}
// closed+NEW returns false and is not CONFIRMED: unavailable, never an unaudited ordinary DENY.
// CONFIRMED only renders the existing outcome; NEW after a PDP ALLOW still performs this handoff.
```

```java
String resolveRegistration(String resourceAlias, URI canonicalIssuer) {
    EdgeRegistrationResourceBindingBO resource = configuredResources.get(resourceAlias);
    requireConfiguredAlias(resource); // unknown tuple is unavailable, no inferred URI/issuer
    return canonicalIssuer == null ? resource.getDefaultRegistrationId()
            : requireExactConfiguredValue(resource.getIssuerRegistrationIds(), canonicalIssuer.toASCIIString());
}
// Caller holds existing lifecycle lease/fence and checks NEW for null issuer, ACTIVE for canonical issuer.
// Explicit real login maps back to one alias; ACTIVE another issuer rejects before native request.
// No fallback/default for ACTIVE, no createdAt/deadline reset, no new selection BO/helper layer.
```

```java
@Test bootDefaultJpaOwnsSelectedOutboxManager() {
  DataSource logicalDS=mock(DataSource.class);
  EntityManagerFactory emf=mock(EntityManagerFactory.class,withSettings().extraInterfaces(EntityManagerFactoryInfo.class));
  when(((EntityManagerFactoryInfo)emf).getDataSource()).thenReturn(logicalDS);
  when(((EntityManagerFactoryInfo)emf).getJpaDialect()).thenReturn(new HibernateJpaDialect());
  ApplicationContextRunner runner=bootJpaOwnerFixture(logicalDS,emf);
  // Exact AutoConfigurations HibernateJpaAutoConfiguration, DataSourceTransactionManagerAutoConfiguration,
  // TransactionAutoConfiguration/TransactionManagerCustomizationAutoConfiguration; explicit test EMF avoids real factory.
  // No hand-written JpaTM bean, no Admin main scan, polling/listeners false; explicit PostgreSQL dialect/no DDL.
  runner.run(ctx -> {
    assertThat(ctx).hasNotFailed().hasSingleBean(PlatformTransactionManager.class);
    JpaTransactionManager manager=(JpaTransactionManager)ctx.getBean("transactionManager");
    assertSame(logicalDS,manager.getDataSource()); assertSame(emf,manager.getEntityManagerFactory());
    assertEquals("transactionManager",ctx.getBeanFactory().getBeanDefinition("transactionManager").getFactoryMethodName());
    assert factoryBeanName identifies actual HibernateJpaConfiguration;
    assertSame(manager,new OutboxInfrastructureResolver().resolve(ctx.getBeanFactory(),explicitDefaultOutboxProps).transactionManager());
    verify(logicalDS,never()).getConnection();
  });
}
@Test competingNamedJdbcManagerBacksOffAndFailsConfiguredSelection() {
  bootJpaOwnerFixture(logicalDS,emf).withBean("legacyJdbcManager",DataSourceTransactionManager.class,
      () -> new DataSourceTransactionManager(logicalDS)).run(ctx -> {
    assertThat(ctx).hasNotFailed().hasSingleBean(PlatformTransactionManager.class).doesNotHaveBean("transactionManager");
    assertThatThrownBy(() -> resolver.resolve(ctx.getBeanFactory(),explicitDefaultOutboxProps))
      .isInstanceOf(OutboxConfigurationException.class).hasMessageContaining("transactionManager");
    // Exactly one existing named JDBC manager; no second fallback TM or alias rewrite.
  });
}
```

- Implementation pseudocode:
```java
static boolean supportsSelectedLocalTransaction(PlatformTransactionManager manager,DataSource selected,ClassLoader loader) {
  if(manager instanceof DataSourceTransactionManager jdbc) return jdbc.getDataSource()==selected;
  return ClassUtils.isPresent("org.springframework.orm.jpa.JpaTransactionManager",loader)
      && ClassUtils.isPresent("jakarta.persistence.EntityManagerFactory",loader)
      && JpaTransactionManagerSupport.matches(manager,selected);
}
private static class JpaTransactionManagerSupport {
  static boolean matches(PlatformTransactionManager manager,DataSource selected) {
    return manager instanceof JpaTransactionManager jpa && jpa.getDataSource()==selected;
  }
  static boolean isJpa(PlatformTransactionManager manager) { return manager instanceof JpaTransactionManager; }
}
resolve(beanFactory,properties): keep unique/explicit/primary selection;
  recognize known JDBC/JPA local type (Jpa only after both exact type presence gates with beanFactory.getBeanClassLoader());
  known type with wrong/null DS -> original mismatch exception;
  unknown pure-selection behavior unchanged; MP validation below rejects unsupported.
// Reuse existing aop/TransactionalMessageMethodValidator#isAsynchronous ClassUtils.isPresent pattern.
// No Class.forName/getMethod/invoke/class simple-name guessing, no generic businessUtils/new crosscontext JPA_PRESENT.
// ORM absent or API absent must not load the typed helper; no compile API import/dependency added.
// Unknown PTM pure selection unchanged; default MP store rejects controlled, not LinkageError.
// Retain noarg constructor, Bean name, public resolve signature and OutboxInfrastructure record fields.
```

```java
  fields -> resource.mechanical_facts.declaredFields; no active field policy; update app version/build/checksum CAS exactly1;
  flush; result pending counts; any exception rollback; commitUnknown compare on fresh connection, no repair/no autoGrant;
}
```

## 12. Review and Acceptance

### 12.1 Original requirement fidelity

主Spec的13项要求分别映射§3/§10和19Steps。源码、生成产品与真实集成都是必需交付；先前自身加固仅作基线，不把它重复计入新执行成果。所有USER同时校验scope与已有fine权限，SERVICE固定target/aud/leastscope，旧Grant没有自动扩大。

### 12.2 Effective Spec fidelity

三个规范附录的五BFF协议、78native合同、44目录意图、15写语义、九CLI/四testprovision文件、24livecases全部在Steps覆盖。SQL/history及业务成功DTO/SDL/PB保留；native query未定义readmask差异不捏造，GraphQL/PB不依赖Jackson mask。Agent仍六层，外部模型推理输入及历史生产迁移不虚报。

### 12.3 File-order and executability review

§5全局每path一次，§7按各Step严格文件序列。共享文件只在各Step负责的symbol阶段写；closed compile前置与主RED分开。任何编译/制品/环境错误都不能充当行为RED；每Step所有GREEN、17MC/10literal和focusedcommit/新HEAD完成后才下一Step。Step16派生输出只验证、不stage，Step18只sanitized运行证据，19审计不是emptycommit。

### 12.4 Spec simplicity and implementation-necessity review

沿原observer/spool/IdpServiceOAuth2Client/PDP/field owner/Outbox/GraphQL公共API/生成器。具体使用Decorator复用完整验签观测、受控target Strategy隔离USER/SERVICE选择、原lease/CAS封装BFF并发、既有Domain Service/Outbox保证字段规则一致性；简单映射和守卫直接实现，不造第二个框架、ThreadLocal、cache、registry或业务层。
